fact: UNICEF says it has supported MINEDUC for over five years to move the EMIS from paper to a fully digital web-based system, with the SDMS operational as a component of the envisioned digital EMIS.
A GPE blog by Educate! staff says Rwanda's School Data Management System houses the unique ID number of every teacher and all the nation's students, almost 4 million.
The Harvard CAS field report says Rwanda's Ministry of Education runs the web-based SDMS, with which annual education statistics are now compiled in a fraction of the time.
The report says, from a headteacher, that every student is assigned a unique ID in the SDMS, which tracks enrolment and attendance per student, with school compliance up from 40% to 70-80%.
